| Dual Survivors

|colspan="6" align="left"|'''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|schoolyard|1}} A challenge occurred on Day 1 that would determine who would select the Batang and Guntao tribes.<br />
{{note|ambassador|2}} As the two ambassadors for the merge tribe, Laurent and Patrick had to cast an extra vote for someone<br />at the first post-merge Tribal Council. They chose to cast an extra vote against Érick.<br />
{{note|tie|3}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote will commence.<br />
{{note|final4|4}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Simon came in last<br />and was eliminated.<br />
{{note|jurytie|5}} According to the rules of ''Koh-Lanta'', if a tie for Sole Survivor occurs, both finalists are declared winners.
{{refend}}
